title: The future of food — новые слова

items.example: You should eat a variety of vegetables every day.
items.mnemonic: Индейцы в вигваме хрустят овощами — eat a variety of vegetables, овощей.

items.example: In some countries, people eat fried insects as a snack.
items.mnemonic: Инспектор жарит закуску — people eat fried insects, насекомых.

items.example: Lab-grown meat could be a sustainable alternative to traditional farming.
items.mnemonic: Лаба выращивает котлеты — lab-grown meat, мясо из лаборатории.

items.example: I prefer to buy organic fruit and vegetables.
items.mnemonic: Органик с грядки — prefer to buy organic, органическое.

items.example: Processed food often contains too much salt and sugar.
items.mnemonic: Процесс напичкан солью и сахаром — processed food, полуфабрикаты.

items.example: Genetically modified crops can resist pests and diseases.
items.mnemonic: Модем скрестил пшеницу с кактусом — genetically modified crops устойчивы.

items.example: Fishing must be sustainable to protect ocean life.
items.mnemonic: Суета вокруг океана — fishing must be sustainable, экологичным.

items.example: Good nutrition is essential for a healthy lifestyle.
items.mnemonic: Нутрия знает толк в питании — good nutrition, питание важно.

items.example: Beans, lentils, and tofu are excellent sources of protein.
items.mnemonic: Фасоль полна протеина — excellent sources of protein, белка.

items.example: Some people avoid dairy because they are lactose intolerant.
items.mnemonic: Доярка избегает молочного — avoid dairy, молочные продукты.

items.example: A vegan diet excludes all animal products.
items.mnemonic: Веган вычеркнул всё животное — a vegan diet, веганский.

items.example: This drink contains artificial colours and flavours.
items.mnemonic: Артист пьёт краску — this drink contains artificial colours, искусственные.
